$description: Platform-neutral normalization of design-tokens.json's typography layer. fontSize/lineHeight are the shared px-equivalent numbers; each platform generator converts to its own scaling unit (web rem, Android sp, iOS Dynamic Type pt) per shared/tokens.json#/units.

fontFamily.webArabic: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif

arabicAdjustments.note: Applied only to text runs detected/tagged as Arabic script, layered on top of the shared scale below — never a separate type scale.

responsive.note: Only display.* and heading.h1/h2 scale down below desktop — heading.h3/h4, body.*, label.*, and caption stay constant across all breakpoints.

showcaseCorroboration.reason: The showcase's raw CSS was grepped for font-size declarations, but the showcase does not label which rule corresponds to which named type-scale step (it uses component-scoped class names, not typography.scale.* names) — so per-step showcase pixel values are not cross-referenced individually here to avoid conflating a component's own font-size with the semantic scale. The design-tokens.json values above are used as-is (rank 2 authority); confirmed present and legible at the showcase's own Landing hero rendering during the D49 visual pass (heading renders at the desktop 48px display.large step, matching).
